credentials.description: API key, sent as `api-key` (and `Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key` for Azure Speech). Required unless `apiKey`, `apiKeyProvider` or an Entra `tokenProvider` is supplied.
Azure resource name used to build `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com/openai`. Required unless `resourceName` or `baseURL` is set.

notes: OpenAI models deployed on Azure, using the Responses API by default plus Chat, completions, embeddings, images, transcription and speech, addressed by deployment name. Authenticate with an API key or a Microsoft Entra ID token provider; MAI Voice, MAI Transcribe and MAI Image models use their Azure-specific APIs.
